title: Content Backlog Item
description: One numbered topic from a bulk content-idea source (e.g. input/ilk_1000_icerik.docx) - the studio's content-strategy layer above individual PRJ-* projects. Produced by scripts/build_content_backlog.py, one entry per numbered item in the source. tier decides which production path an item takes: short_new (fresh Flow/ElevenLabs generation, ~30-90s), short_repurpose (cut from an already-rendered master on Kaggle, near-zero new generation), long (30-60min single documentary, full M23 pipeline), epic (2h+, planning-only until explicitly greenlit - see 2026-08-09 content-roadmap plan).

backlog_id.description: Stable id for this backlog entry, independent of the source document's own numbering (which is a display order, not an identity).

source_number.description: The 1-1050 number as it appears in the source document (input/ilk_1000_icerik.txt) - kept for traceability back to the original list, never used as the primary key.

section.description: The named section/bölüm heading this item appeared under in the source (e.g. "AŞARŞILIK EVRENİ", "BÜYÜK DEVLETLER").

title.description: The topic/hook title as written in the source, verbatim.

source.description: "new" for short_new/long/epic items with no existing footage. For short_repurpose, "repurpose:<kaggle-ref>:<filename>" pointing at the already-rendered master this item's clip will be cut from (e.g. "repurpose:mehmetkync16/ai-audiobook-studio-videos:ryskulov_mektubu_master.mp4").

consolidation_group.description: For long/epic tier items only: several source_numbers in the same section are produced as ONE video/series rather than one-per-item (e.g. all 30 BÜYÜK DEVLETLER numbers collapse into 8 empire videos). Null for short-tier items, which are always 1 item = 1 delivered short. Group id is human-readable, e.g. "buyuk-devletler-goktürkler".

project_ref.description: PRJ-* project_id once production has actually started on this item (or its consolidation_group), null before that.
